prompts.text: A large pack-hunting predator dinosaur gives rough guttural calls and clicking growls, three separate calls with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A large pack-hunting predator dinosaur lets out a sharp rasping roar, three separate times with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A large pack-hunting predator dinosaur roars hoarsely in pain, four separate cries with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A large pack-hunting predator dinosaur gives a long fading dying cry, two separate times with long pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A large pack-hunting predator dinosaur: bites with a crunching snap and a snarl, four separate attacks with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
Heavy quick footsteps of a large two-legged predator, well spaced and distinct. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
